newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay cotton market was closed on Monday for a Hindu festival. The market reopens on Tuesday.
On Friday, cotton lost some recent gains poor demand and new crop arrivals but scattered support from the state-run Cotton Corporation of India arrested a sharp fall in the prices.
In spot, Bengal-deshi (ready delivery) fell 40/70 rupees to 950/1,000 rupees per maund (37.32 kg). Punjab saw-ginned eased 25/40 rupees to 1,635/1,690 rupees per maund.
